why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P2 state-1.22): `tests/quality/matrix/routes.ts` reads only the top-level files of `apps/playground/src/routes`, while its doc says a route added there joins the matrix. A nested route (`routes/cycle/state.tsx`, the cycle build) is never checked. Moving it there was the only way to merge: at top level the matrix failed it on kit findings (state-1.21) that a cycle PR, which may not touch `packages/basalt-ui/`, cannot waive in `known.ts`.
what: The quality matrix reads every playground route, nested ones too, and a cycle route's findings can be listed.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/tests/quality/matrix/*.test.ts only where the route list is asserted
change: `routePaths()` walks `src/routes` recursively and maps a nested file to its path (`cycle/state.tsx` to `/cycle/state`), skipping `__`-prefixed and `-`-prefixed files as TanStack's generator does. Every finding `/cycle/state` then reports goes into `known.ts` one item at a time, with `owner: 'v3-state-1-visual'` (or the row that owns the component), so the gate stays green and the full run fails the entry once the fix removes the finding. Test: `routePaths()` includes `/cycle/state`.
commits: test: or fix: one commit in packages/basalt-ui.
proof: make check; the sampled matrix passes with `/cycle/state` in it.
acceptance: The sampled matrix runs `/cycle/state` at both cells and passes, with each of its findings listed by item in known.ts
out_of_scope: Fixing the findings (v3-state-1-visual and the rows that own the components).
